court: Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit

issues.label: Standard of review of agency findings
issues.why: Court must apply substantial evidence deference to factual findings and de novo to legal questions.

issues.label: Exhaustion of due process claims
issues.why: Certain due process arguments were not raised before the BIA, potentially barring review.

issues.label: Adverse credibility - specific and cogent reasons
issues.why: Court must assess whether each of the four grounds is supported by specific, cogent, record-based reasons.

issues.label: Totality of circumstances credibility standard
issues.why: REAL ID Act requires credibility assessed under totality of circumstances including consistency, demeanor, and plausibility.

issues.label: Materiality of credibility inconsistencies
issues.why: Court must evaluate whether cited inconsistencies go to the heart or are trivial under REAL ID Act.

issues.label: Effect of adverse credibility on corroboration
issues.why: Court must determine whether corroborating evidence could rehabilitate discredited testimony.

issues.label: Sufficiency of corroborating evidence analysis
issues.why: Court must review whether IJ properly evaluated available corroboration and gave notice of what was needed.

issues.label: Past persecution establishment
issues.why: Beatings, arrest, torture at black site may establish past persecution triggering presumption of future fear.

issues.label: Nexus to protected ground
issues.why: Court must assess whether harm was on account of political opinion or party membership.

issues.label: Well-founded fear of future persecution
issues.why: Court must evaluate objective and subjective components of future persecution fear.

issues.label: Internal relocation reasonableness and burden
issues.why: Court must assess who bears burden and whether relocation to Kanfufu was reasonable given government persecutor.

issues.label: Relocation where government is persecutor
issues.why: Presumption against reasonable relocation applies when persecutor is the national government.

issues.label: Withholding of removal standard
issues.why: Court must apply the clear probability standard distinct from asylum's well-founded fear.

issues.label: CAT independent of credibility
issues.why: CAT claim must be assessed on all record evidence even after adverse credibility finding.

issues.label: CAT particularized risk of torture
issues.why: Court must determine whether record shows likely torture and government acquiescence independent of testimony.

issues.label: Government acquiescence/state action for CAT
issues.why: Torture must be by or with consent or acquiescence of public officials.

issues.label: Due process outcome-affected standard
issues.why: Court must apply whether outcome may have been affected by the alleged violation.

issues.label: Pro se applicant procedural fairness
issues.why: Applicant appeared pro se, implicating duty to develop record and ensure fair hearing.

issues.label: Family members' derivative claims
issues.why: Court must address whether wife and family have derivative or independent relief eligibility.

issues.label: Adequacy of BIA's reasoning
issues.why: Court must determine whether BIA independently reviewed or merely adopted IJ rationale.

issues.label: Country conditions evidence consideration
issues.why: Court must assess whether agency properly weighed Angola country conditions bearing on risk.
